{{Top|leg}}
'''Gesenix Mining''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporation that operated on [[Andasala/Legends|Andasala]], and was responsible for the foundation of the settlements on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], trade was disrupted, and the corporation eventually went out of business.
